scripts.build-hotfix: (npm run eslint)&&(npm run build-remove-old-files)&&(vite build --mode production)
scripts.build-production: (npm run eslint)&&(npm run build-remove-old-files)&&(vite build --mode production)
scripts.build-staging: (npm run eslint)&&(npm run build-remove-old-files)&&(vite build --mode staging)
scripts.build-tests: (npm run eslint)&&(npm run build-remove-old-files)&&(vite build --mode test)
scripts.eslint: (npm run check-outdated)&&(npm run check-circleci)&&(./node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js -c eslint.config.mjs src/** tests/**/*.js playwright.config.js *.mjs)
scripts.eslint-fix: (npm run check-outdated)&&(npm run check-circleci)&&(./node_modules/eslint/bin/eslint.js -c eslint.config.mjs --fix src/** tests/**/*.js playwright.config.js *.mjs)
scripts.tests-start-with-build: (npm run eslint)&&(npm run build-tests)&&(playwright install --with-deps)&&(export CHECK_SCREENSHOTS=TRUE;playwright test)
scripts.tests-start-with-build-no-screenshots: (npm run eslint)&&(npm run build-tests)&&(playwright install --with-deps)&&(export CHECK_SCREENSHOTS=FALSE;playwright test)
scripts.update-tools: REQUIRED_NVM_VERSION=$(jq -r '.engines.nvm' package.json) && REQUIRED_NODE_VERSION=$(jq -r '.engines.node' package.json) && export NVM_DIR="${NVM_DIR:-$HOME/.nvm}" && if [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ]; then . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; elif [ -s "/opt/homebrew/opt/nvm/nvm.sh" ]; then . "/opt/homebrew/opt/nvm/nvm.sh"; fi && CURRENT_NVM_VERSION=$(nvm --version 2>/dev/null || echo '') && REQUIRED_NVM_NORMALIZED=$(echo "$REQUIRED_NVM_VERSION" | sed 's/^v//') && CURRENT_NVM_NORMALIZED=$(echo "$CURRENT_NVM_VERSION" | sed 's/^v//') && if [ "$CURRENT_NVM_NORMALIZED" != "$REQUIRED_NVM_NORMALIZED" ]; then if brew list nvm &>/dev/null 2>&1; then brew upgrade nvm && [ -s "/opt/homebrew/opt/nvm/nvm.sh" ] && . "/opt/homebrew/opt/nvm/nvm.sh"; else curl -o- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvm-sh/nvm/$REQUIRED_NVM_VERSION/install.sh" | bash && [ -s "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" ] && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh"; fi; fi && CURRENT_NODE_VERSION=$(node --version 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^v//' || echo '') && REQUIRED_NODE_NORMALIZED=$(echo "$REQUIRED_NODE_VERSION" | sed 's/^v//') && CURRENT_NODE_NORMALIZED=$(echo "$CURRENT_NODE_VERSION" | sed 's/^v//') && if [ "$CURRENT_NODE_NORMALIZED" != "$REQUIRED_NODE_NORMALIZED" ]; then nvm install "$REQUIRED_NODE_VERSION" && nvm use "$REQUIRED_NODE_VERSION" && nvm alias default "$REQUIRED_NODE_VERSION"; fi && echo "nvm: $(nvm --version)" && echo "Node.js: $(node --version)" && echo "npm: $(npm --version)"
